task.speaker: client
task.text: Because the main and sensor boards slide vertically into the enclosure rails, each is mounted with its long edge at the top. Put the high-pin-count main connectors along that long top edge on both boards, with none on either side or the bottom. On the main board, J\_SENSOR\_PWR and J\_SENSOR\_SIG must line up with J\_SENSOR\_PWR and J\_SENSOR\_SIG on the sensor board at the same relative locations along the top edge; this keeps the inter-board cables short and lets them run straight between the boards.
